info.title: Gremion calendar module — event lifecycle + CalDAV sync events
info.description: Terminal events emitted by the calendar module (which lives in the module repo, not here) for event lifecycle changes and CalDAV push sync failures. Four events: event.created, event.updated, event.deleted, caldav.sync.failed. Subject grammar: gremion.{tenantId}.calendar.{event} — built by calendarSubject() in @gremion/ports/broker (single source of truth for the wire subject, mirroring D-P1-7's newsletterSubject() pattern). EventEnvelope field-matched to packages/ports/src/broker.ts EventEnvelope interface. JetStream mapping: Nats-Msg-Id = envelope.eventId. The leaf's egress publish emits; its audit consumer — which lives in the module repo, not here — consumes on gremion.*.calendar.> (5-token subjects, '>' extension per broker.ts subjectMatches). The AsyncAPI channel addresses are verified at test time against calendarSubject() — see packages/ports/src/calendar-contract.test.ts.

calendarEventCreated.description: Published when a calendar event is created. Subject built by calendarSubject(tenantId, 'event.created') — never construct the subject string directly.

tenantId.description: Tenant UUID (resolved by UUID, not slug — #173).

calendarEventUpdated.description: Published when a calendar event is updated. Subject built by calendarSubject(tenantId, 'event.updated') — never construct the subject string directly.

tenantId.description: Tenant UUID (resolved by UUID, not slug — #173).

calendarEventDeleted.description: Published when a calendar event is deleted. Subject built by calendarSubject(tenantId, 'event.deleted') — never construct the subject string directly.

tenantId.description: Tenant UUID (resolved by UUID, not slug — #173).

calendarCaldavSyncFailed.description: Published when the leaf's CalDAV push ticker (caldav-sync) fails to push an event to Nextcloud. Subject built by calendarSubject(tenantId, 'caldav.sync.failed') — never construct the subject string directly.

tenantId.description: Tenant UUID (resolved by UUID, not slug — #173).

publishCalendarEventCreated.summary: Calendar leaf publishes event.created when a new event is inserted.

publishCalendarEventUpdated.summary: Calendar leaf publishes event.updated when an existing event is modified.

publishCalendarEventDeleted.summary: Calendar leaf publishes event.deleted when an event is removed (incl. bulk delete-by-external-id).

publishCalendarCaldavSyncFailed.summary: Calendar leaf publishes caldav.sync.failed when a queued CalDAV push exhausts retries against Nextcloud.

consumeCalendarEvents.summary: Consumed by the calendar audit consumer, which writes the audit trail and lives in the module repo, not here. At-least-once delivery; consumers MUST dedupe on eventId. Consumer pattern: gremion.*.calendar.> (5-token subjects).

eventId.description: Also the Nats-Msg-Id (JetStream dedup). Matches @gremion/ports EventEnvelope.eventId.

eventType.description: Short event type. Values: 'event.created' | 'event.updated' | 'event.deleted' | 'caldav.sync.failed'. Matches @gremion/ports CalendarEvent.

tenantId.description: Tenant UUID, duplicated from the subject for envelope-only consumers (#173: by UUID, not slug). Matches @gremion/ports EventEnvelope.tenantId.

correlationId.description: x-correlation-id of the originating request. Matches @gremion/ports EventEnvelope.correlationId.

payload.description: Event-specific payload (see envelope sub-schemas). Matches @gremion/ports EventEnvelope.payload.

source.description: Event source (manual | helios | holiday | imported etc.).

changedFields.description: Names of fields that changed in this update.

eventDbId.description: The calendar_events row id of the deleted event.

externalId.description: External id, if the delete was a bulk deleteEventsByExternalId operation.

eventDbId.description: The calendar_events row id whose CalDAV push failed.

error.description: Human-readable error message from the failed push attempt.
